name: IES Eval Harness — 4-Tier Assessment Framework
description: Instruments IES with an automated 4-tier evaluation system covering mechanical success tracking (Tier 1), structural assertion checks (Tier 2), on-demand letter grading (Tier 3), and controller feedback sampling (Tier 4). Wires 4 hook scripts into the Claude Code agent lifecycle, adds 3 new Rigby skills, integrates eval health checks into weekly-review, daily-review, and evolution-deployment workflows, and includes a post-build adversarial fix set of 15 targeted corrections validated by code review.

compatibility.notes: Requires Claude Code hooks support (SubagentStart, SubagentStop, PostToolUseFailure, SessionEnd). Requires Python 3 available at hook runtime. IES_ROOT environment variable recommended; falls back to /Users/davidohara/develop/jarvis for local use.

changelog: New: 4-tier eval harness instrumentation wired into Claude Code agent lifecycle via 4 hook scripts
New: systems/eval-harness/ directory with schema, assertion definitions, and utility scripts
New: rigby-eval-grade skill for on-demand Tier 3 letter grading
New: rigby-eval-analyze skill for trend analysis and pattern detection
New: rigby-eval-dashboard skill for HTML visualization of eval metrics
New: Tier 2 assertion files for morning-briefing, weekly-review, daily-review, evolution-deployment, and self-assertions for the eval skills themselves
New: evolution-deployment step-04-benchmark-snapshot captures eval baseline before each evolution
New: weekly-review step-08 owns eval summary and workflow close (writes state.yaml complete)
Fix: Tier 2 assertion lookup uses workflow/skill name, not agent type — assertions now reliably activate
Fix: Tier 1 mechanical block preserved from real-time accumulation, not overwritten by stop hook
Fix: agent_id stored in stubs for reliable SubagentStop correlation (multi-agent safe)
Fix: yaml import at top-level in eval-agent-stop.py — no more silent assertion failures
Fix: tool_failures count flows through stop hook correctly (not reset to 0)
Fix: failure_entry objects attached to eval records — full tool failure log preserved
Fix: all hooks use IES_ROOT env var with local fallback (no hardcoded paths)
Fix: atomic writes with fcntl.LOCK_EX across all hooks — no partial write corruption
Fix: trigger inferred from state.yaml content, not hardcoded to unknown
Fix: log_info separated from log_error in session-end hook — no false error log noise
Fix: benchmark snapshot comparison deferred until post-exercise runs accumulate
Fix: weekly-review routing table and architecture description corrected to 8-step
